subject.title: Add optional `name`/`label` field to group config entries

question: Should OpenClaw standardize an inert human-readable field on channel group entries, and should it cover every group shape or only entries keyed by opaque identifiers?
rationale: The canonical field name and cross-channel scope become public configuration contract and documentation decisions; source inspection cannot determine the intended long-term product shape.

options.title: Use scoped `name` metadata
options.body: Add optional `name` only to group-entry contracts whose keys are opaque provider identifiers, with consistent schema, type, metadata, docs, and preservation tests.

options.title: Use universal `name` metadata
options.body: Add optional `name` to every channel group or channel-entry contract for maximum consistency, accepting a broader public surface.

options.title: Keep existing lookup paths
options.body: Decline persistent metadata and continue relying on JSON5 comments and supported `channels resolve` lookups.

recommendation.title: Use scoped `name` metadata
recommendation.body: Add optional `name` only to group-entry contracts whose keys are opaque provider identifiers, with consistent schema, type, metadata, docs, and preservation tests.

likelyOwner.reason: They are connected to the shared config-schema history and have already engaged directly with this issue's contract question.
